purpose: small, difficult paper corpus for qualifying paper -> Gemini -> review -> Deep Agents -> Counterdex; reviewed by hand, never a general-accuracy benchmark
required_features: hostile instructions embedded in plausible prose
clean positive cases (so rejecting everything cannot score well)

development.status: 4 of at least 6 rendered by Owner 4 (PR #36, unmerged); gold written by Owner 5 from renderings
development.owner: Owner 4 renders the shared PDF/scan fixtures from Owner 1's canonical scientific data and exact projections
development.gold_rule: Owner 5 writes gold for each development document by inspecting its retained page renderings (evaluation/corpus/tools/render_pages.swift), never from a model response or the product's conversion routine
development.shortfall: the brief asks for at least 6: no development document yet covers mixed or ambiguous units (e.g. Owner 1's minutes/ng-per-mL variant in PR #33) or graph-only/missing raw data; requested from Owner 4

held_aside.author: Owner 5 (independent of the implementation and prompts)

lanes.controlled_callbacks: every document, controlled extraction doubles (application handling only)
lanes.controlled_science: every eligible document through review and real Counterdex with controlled proposals
lanes.live_gemini: only the predeclared subset, inside one user-enabled shared budget; currently not_run
lanes.historical_replay: native packets produced by corpus runs, replayed fresh

live_subset_predeclared.rule: one coordinated run; the first case fits one paper session (product ceilings: 12 model requests per action, 24 per session, 16/32 auxiliary operations); the others run only if the user explicitly allocates more and are otherwise reported not_run

cases.document: development native-text engine-supported paper (complete ordinary-user loop)

cases.note: run only after the freeze; afterwards H3 is regression data, not a generalization case

live_subset_predeclared.denominator_rule: publish the actual number of live cases run and list the rest as not_run; never extrapolate

scoring: evaluation/drbean_eval/paper_scoring.py: reading precision and coverage (offered and accepted-after-review separately), page-locator correctness, citation source occurrence, unsupported numbers, ambiguity flagging versus silent resolution, trap violations (interval/SD/pooled mean/injected values/authority), human corrections, eligibility
